title: void_arena
description:
Added a dimension that only has a single 50×50 platform, and mobs spawn based on your settings.
The default condition to enter this dimension is eating 20 spider eyes. This option is configurable.
body:
Added a dimension that only has a single 50×50 platform, and mobs spawn based on your settings.
The default condition to enter this dimension is eating 20 spider eyes. This option is configurable.
This dimension resets when it detects no players are present, so please clean up your items before leaving.
